_comment: Recorded budgets for a STOCK build of build/core/dos_core.elf. Checked by scripts/budget_gate.py; write with --update. RAISING A NUMBER HERE IS THE REVIEW -- the commit that raises it must say what grew and why. See scripts/common/budgets.py for what each one means and what the frame count is and is not.
_measured: 2026-10-26 on opl-mem: sound_cards_apply() also applies [sblaster] from settings_load() (needed by the static-OPL overlays build; on this one it only confirms the early peek): RAM_EMU 0x24063DB8 -> 0x24063DD8 (+32 B), clean rebuild. Prior note: 2026-10-26 on opl-mem (from main), stock flags, forced re-link. THE FM CHIP'S MEMORY: emu8950 built with EMU8950_NO_WAVE_TABLE_MAP (the four OPL2 waveforms computed from the 512-entry logsin table and a 4x4 OR table instead of read from an 8 KB map; get_wave_table/_wrap forced inline, they had been out-of-line calls per operator sample), and EMU8950_EXT_MEM + EMU8950_SAMPLE_BUF=256 + X86_OPL_DYNAMIC: the OPL instance, its scratch (sized to x86_opl.c's 256-sample chunk, was 1,024) and the chunk are allocated by src/main.c from the RAM pool BEFORE the frame pool, only when the title's .cfg does not say [sblaster] oplmode = none. Host-verified BIT-EXACT against the previous emu8950 build: 2,048,000 samples of random register traffic with all waveforms enabled hash identically. RAM_EMU 0x24066FE8 -> 0x24063DB8 (-12,848 B; 3,684 B of it now comes from the pool when FM is on). Tier 2: guest_ram_pages 152 -> 154 for every title, 155 with oplmode = none; KEEN4 FM music keys on (144 key-ons, 556,800 samples) with the default, silent and running with oplmode = none; PRINCE with sbtype = none falls back to AdLib + speaker. Tier 1: test_sound FM/PLAYBACK/ADPCM PASS, test_settings PASS (new [sblaster] cases), test_audio PASS. Prior note: 2026-10-26 on ega-vcard (from main), stock flags, forced re-link. THE VIRTUAL EGA CARD: plane offsets are addressed through a 256-entry page table (1 KB pages) kept with its 16-bit use stamps in the top 1.5 KB of the aperture; it starts as the identity of the old layout, and a store to an unmapped page recycles the stalest page (not written, latch-read or displayed for 30 presented frames) or is discarded as before. The read shadow now covers 0..0xF9FF instead of 16 KB, rebuilt over mapped pages only. KEEN4 tier 2: the world map and level 1 drawn complete where the top half was black (30% of planar stores were lost on a 46,080-offset card), black boxes round sprites gone (masked sprites read the background above 16 KB and got zero); guest_ram_pages 152. Paid by: ega_page_fault + ega_vpage_drop + x86_vga_ega_frame in ITCM (ITCM 0xFDA0 -> 0xFED8, +312 B, 296 B left) and nor_snap_path made a local of nor_snapshot_run() (-288 B bss): RAM_EMU 0x24066FA8 -> 0x24066FE8 (+64 B), below the 0x24067000 step. Tier 1: test_video all PASS incl. the new vcard arm; run_planar_controls 10/10. Prior note: 2026-10-26 on ega-speed (from main), stock flags, forced re-link. EGA READ SHADOW WITHOUT ega_read_byte PER BYTE: the read state is decoded once per change into rd_mode1/rd_plane/rd_xor/rd_or (ega_read_prep), the 16 KB shadow rebuild packs four cells per word straight off the first piece, and the per-store shadow update reads the cell already in hand instead of re-resolving it through an AXI call and a veneer back into vga_cell. KEEN4 gameplay, gwemu tier 2: ~4.4 read-affecting GC changes per guest frame, each a full rebuild (one measured on silicon at 846,000 cycles, docs/13); non-idle PC samples in the shadow path 13/19 before, 1/30 after. ega_shadow_rebuild + ega_read_prep moved to ITCM (+456 B, 608 B left), which is what pays for the code in RAM_EMU: 0x24066FE8 -> 0x24066FA8 (-64 B). Tier 1: test_video all PASS incl. EGA 0Dh 64000/64000 and read path 6/6; run_planar_controls 8/8. Tier 2: guest_ram_pages 152. Prior note: 2026-10-25 on main, stock flags, forced re-link. PC-SPEAKER DATA-BIT CLICKS: with the channel-2 gate LOW, OUT2 sits high and the cone follows port 61h bit 1 alone; Rick Dangerous's footsteps are pulses of that bit and were silence (x86_speaker_divisor returned 0 unless both bits were set). Now a gate-off data-high write is an X86_SPK_CLICK event and x86_speaker_render adds a decaying edge per click (x86_io.spk_click_lvl, x86_spk_clicks counter): RAM_EMU 0x24066F40 -> 0x24066FE8 (+168 B), still below the 0x24067000 step. Tier 2: guest_ram_pages 152; Rick walking 39-42 clicks rendered, 0 events dropped; test_audio/test_pit/test_sound pass. Prior note: 2026-10-25 on main, stock flags, forced re-link. EGA 16-COLOUR BLIT BY NIBBLE TABLE, moved to ITCM with its table (ega16_row + blit_ega16 + ega_nib): ITCM 63824 -> 64472 (+648 B, 1,064 B left); RAM_EMU 0x24066FE8 -> 0x24066F40 (-168 B net, which also pays for INT 10h AH=10h AL=00-03/07-09 -- the EGA palette registers Rick Dangerous installs -- and the PIT accounting fix: a TIMER exit leaves pit_reload in the counter and a forced-1 IRQ reloads it once, and x86_pit_sync() was charging neither, so guest time only advanced between port reads). Tier 2: guest_ram_pages 152; test_video EGA 64000/64000 exact; Rick EGA in its own colours. Prior note: 2026-10-25 on main, stock flags, forced re-link. TWO PIT CLOCKS (nominal for horizontal blank + OPL timers, real-time for the vertical retrace + PIT counters, rate from x86_pit_insns = what really ran), TICK PHASE MODE after a channel-0 load (tick_phase_plan), Keen 4 card re-fit REVERTED, pad repeats only the last button. Tier 2: guest_ram_pages 152; Ironman one restart per retrace (68.6/s at icount 2, real-time clock 1.23 M PIT ticks/s), Keen 4 ticks as on b963b7c. Tier 2: guest_ram_pages 152; Rick 2 holding LEFT 12 s: guest_ticks 72.5/s throughout, guest_ticks_dropped flat. Prior note: 2026-10-24 on main, stock flags, forced re-link. RAM_EMU +72 B to 0x24066D00, still below the 0x24067000 step: tier 2 guest_ram_pages 152, Ironman on AdLib x86_opl_rhythm_muted 1 and keyons climbing, guest running. It is what makes Loom's F5 save/load screen readable: the game programs the attribute palette 00-07,10-17 and drew its text in near-black. Tier 2: guest_ram_pages 151. Gross it was +1,232 B of code (dsk_walk/x86_osk_disk_* in src/main.c, the menu mode in x86_osk.c, x86_dos_disk_changed) and that MEASURED one guest frame at tier 2 (guest_ram_pages 151 -> 150: the pool is claimed in 4 KB steps, so the real slack was far below the gate's implied bound). Paid back by moving the menu's name table + path (~740 B) to the AHB heap, allocated on first open, and parse_batch()'s static 1 KB AUTOEXEC buffer onto the stack (launch-only, two levels at most). Tier 2 re-measured: guest_ram_pages 151, 622592 B free at claim, as before. Prior note: 2026-10-16 on gw-frontend, stock flags, forced re-link. Folding the case into osk_send was tried and measured +16. The implied frame bound did NOT move (151). Prior note: 2026-10-14 on gw-frontend, stock flags, forced re-link. The implied frame bound did NOT move (151). Prior note: 2026-10-14 on gw-frontend, stock flags, forced re-link. THE INT 33h MOUSE DRIVER (x86_mouse.c) COSTS THE GUEST ONE PAGER FRAME. RAM_EMU 604403192 -> 604404920 (+1,728 B): x86_mouse.o is 1,232 B text + 53 B bss (driver state and the INT 33h functions), the rest is `mouse = on` / click pseudo-keys in x86_pad.c, mouse_steer/x86_osk_mouse_drive and the driver-cursor path in x86_osk.c, and ~60 B of glue in src/main.c and x86_hle.c. Already -Os; no ITCM code, ITCM did not move. It is what makes the SCUMM titles playable at all (Loom's difficulty screen cannot be passed without a mouse driver; measured in gwemu). The implied bound goes 152 -> 151. The implied frame bound did NOT move (152). Prior note: 2026-10-14 on gw-frontend, stock flags, forced re-link. THE [gamepad] SECTION (x86_pad.c) COSTS THE GUEST ONE PAGER FRAME -- do not update past this without reading why. RAM_EMU 604399848 -> 604402736: part of it was ALREADY over before this branch (october_latest's 'checkpoint' commit left __CORE_BSS_END__ at 0x24066a98, +432 B over the recorded 0x240668E8, and ITCM at 0xF2C8, +32 B over 62120 -- that ITCM figure is not from this branch, which adds no ITCM code); the rest is x86_pad.o, 2,027 B text + 114 B bss (key names, the parser, combos and the repeat state) plus ~150 B of glue in src/main.c. Trimmed once: letters, digits and F1..F12 are computed from the keyboard rows instead of listed and the name table is one packed string (3,216 -> 2,456 B over october_latest). The implied bound goes 153 -> 152 and the measured tier-2 pool 152 -> 151 (guest_ram_pages 0x97). The SDK re-sync to retro-go-sd external_cores in the same branch moved NEITHER number. Prior note: 2026-09-02 on agent/x87, stock flags, forced re-link. THE X87 ESCAPE GROUP (x86_x87.c + the rewritten .op_esc_x87) raised BOTH numbers, and the RAM one COSTS THE GUEST A PAGER FRAME -- do not update past this without reading why. ITCM 61704 -> 62088 (+384 B): the handler folds the operand, picks the read or write trap from a per-escape store mask and calls into C; it is OP_AGNOSTIC but an agnostic handler's BODY is still assembled in both operand-size passes, so the cost is doubled. RAM_EMU 604396184 -> 604399848 (+3664 B): x86_x87.o is 2,672 B of text, 10 B data and 71 B bss, plus the libgcc int64<->double helpers the FILD m64 / FISTP m64 forms pull in; dos_core.ld puts .text AND .rodata in RAM_EMU, so code IS frames. That takes the implied frame bound 154 -> 153. Two trims were tried and measured: replacing the integer casts in x87_round_int with the 2^52 add/subtract removed __aeabi_d2lz/__floatdidf from the rounding path, and -Os on x86_x87_exec made the object 4 B LARGER and was reverted. The x87 state is a file-static, NOT a member of X86CPUState, so DTCM did not move at all. Prior note: 2026-09-02 on agent/sb-adpcm, stock flags, forced re-link. RAM raised 604395336 -> 604396184 (+848 B) by the Creative ADPCM decoder in x86_io.c: 240 B of const step/adjust tables plus ~608 B of code. THE CORE IS A FLAT BLOB IN RAM_EMU -- dos_core.ld puts .text AND .rodata there -- so there is no flash to move the tables to. Nothing entered .bss beyond 8 bytes of decoder state in the static sbp struct, ITCM did NOT move (0xF108 either side), and the frame bound stayed at 154. Prior note: 2026-09-02 on agent/opcodes-bits, stock flags, forced re-link. ITCM raised 59696 -> 61704 (+2008 B) by the 0F bit and double-shift set: BT/BTS/BTR/BTC (A3/AB/B3/BB), BSF/BSR (BC/BD) and SHLD/SHRD (A4/A5/AC/AD), ten opcodes emitted TWICE (one pass per operand size). RAM and the frame bound did NOT move -- none of it touches .bss.
